# 100.00 USD bought at 1.35, and the bank keeps 1.00 USD of it as its fee.
#
# The fee is currency leaving the book, so it draws on a cost basis: the
# purchase in the same transaction, given by the guid this file states for it.
# The purchase states its balance as 99.00, already net of the fee, so nothing
# is drawn down a second time.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Bank Fees
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 100 USD at 1.35, the bank keeping 1.00 USD as its fee"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "5b0f4c1e2d3a4f5e8c7b6a5d4e3f2a10"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "135.00"
		cost_basis_balance: "99.00"
	Assets:Bank:USD -1.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "-1.35"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "5b0f4c1e2d3a4f5e8c7b6a5d4e3f2a10"
	Expenses:Bank Fees 1.35 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "1.35"
	Assets:Bank -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-135.00"
